description: Related Data for: Assessing volcanic hazard and exposure in a data poor context: Case study for Ethiopia, Kenya, and Cabo Verde is a hazard data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by DR-NTU (Data). Research data for paper: 'Assessing volcanic hazard and exposure in data poor environments: Case study for Ethiopia, Kenya, and Cabo Verde'. Coverage: Ethiopia, Kenya, Cabo Verde. The portal files it under the publisher DR-NTU (Data). Its tags are Earth and Environmental Sciences, Volcano. The repository dates the deposit 2026; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution Non Commercial 4.0 International. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
